reproduction.method: Student-t Gaussian-Gamma precision EM, genuine SCAD LLA, Lasso and Ridge
reproduction.description: Compare fitted coefficient bias, practical support and independent test prediction for four actual algorithms.
differences: Synthetic correlated regression preserves the original type of experiment but bounds it to 24 features,90 train,200 test and one trial.
Student-t precision-mixture EM substitutes for original NJ/NG/NEG priors; fixed known noise and penalties replace grid cross-validation.
SCAD uses the actual Fan–Li piecewise penalty and coefficient-dependent derivative; it does not repeat the original helper’s constant-Lasso update.
No original paper boxplots, tuning-optimality, exact-zero Student-t sparsity, or benchmark parity claim.

metrics.dataset: Synthetic correlated 90 train / 200 test × 24 features; 4 planted effects
